name: Ryons

attributes.attribute: king of Wales whose cloak held the beards of his slain foes
refused to yield his beard and took the land of Ryons

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Ryons, also known as Riance, is an Arthurian hero. He ruled as king of Wales. His cloak bore a trim of beards shaved from men he slew rather than with fur. When he demanded the beard of King Arthur, the ruler of Camelot refused and instead overcame the land of Ryons.

okr.objective: Present Ryons as an Arthurian king of Wales who prized the beards of his enemies.
key_results: Ryons ruled Wales as its king.
His cloak carried the beards of warriors he killed.
King Arthur refused his demand and conquered his land.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
